details.description: Mistral NeMo Instruct 2407 is the instruction-tuned version of Mistral NeMo Base 2407, a 12-billion-parameter model Mistral AI built jointly with NVIDIA and released in July 2024. It has a 128,000-token context window, was trained with a large proportion of multilingual and code data, and is described by Mistral AI as a drop-in replacement for Mistral 7B. The model supports function calling through Mistral's mistral-inference tooling and the Hugging Face transformers library. Mistral AI's own model-status page lists the Mistral NeMo 12B family, including this instruct release, as deprecated (2026-05-22) and retired from its hosted API as of 2026-07-31.
advantages: 128,000-token context window positioned by Mistral AI as a drop-in replacement for Mistral 7B, per the model card.
Scores 68.0% on MMLU (5-shot) and 83.5% on HellaSwag (0-shot) in Mistral AI's own benchmark table.
Supports function calling via the mistral-inference and transformers frameworks, per the model card.
Trained on multilingual and code data, with multilingual MMLU tested across French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese and Japanese (59.0-64.6%).
disadvantages: Mistral AI's model-status page lists the Mistral NeMo 12B family as deprecated (2026-05-22), retired from Mistral's own hosted API as of 2026-07-31 with Ministral 3 8B as the replacement.
use_cases: Tool-use and function-calling workflows via mistral-inference or transformers.
Applications needing a mid-sized, long-context drop-in replacement for Mistral 7B.

notes: Catalog's max_input/output_tokens (128000) match the model card's stated 128k context window, so no conflict. Mistral AI's model-status page places Mistral NeMo 12B's deprecation on 2026-05-22 and retirement on 2026-07-31, after which Ministral 3 8B is the listed replacement; the catalog's facts carry no deprecation_date for this entry. Named languages come from the card's multilingual-MMLU table, which may not be an exhaustive language list.
